title: KBS: A Korean Benchmark Suite for Foundation Model Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2610.21227v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present a Korean Benchmark Suite (KBS) comprising Ko-ARC, Ko-GSM8K, Ko-EQ-Bench, Ko-WinoGrande, Ko-LAMBADA, and Ko-IFEval, covering six capabilities across 9,396 items. The suite combines review, localization, direct Korean construction, and redesign for Korean, avoiding a translation-only approach to benchmark adaptation. We evaluate Korean-developed models, multilingual open models, and closed API models under protocols that account for model access, prompt format, and scoring differences. Results show that Korean benchmark scores depend on task construction, scoring rules, prompting, and model post-training. These findings suggest that Korean evaluation should report both final scores and the settings used to obtain them.

translated_title: KBS：一个用于基础模型评估的韩语基准测试套件
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一个韩语基准测试套件（KBS），包含Ko-ARC、Ko-GSM8K、Ko-EQ-Bench、Ko-WinoGrande、Ko-LAMBADA和Ko-IFEval，覆盖六项能力，共计9,396个条目。该套件结合了审查、本地化、直接韩语构建以及针对韩语的重新设计，避免了仅通过翻译来适配基准的方法。我们在考虑模型访问方式、提示词格式和评分差异的协议下，评估了韩国开发的模型、多语言开源模型以及闭源API模型。结果表明，韩语基准测试分数取决于任务构建方式、评分规则、提示词以及模型的后训练过程。这些发现表明，韩语模型评估应同时报告最终分数以及获得这些分数所使用的设置。
tldr: 该论文提出了韩语基准测试套件KBS，通过审查、本地化、直接构建和重新设计（而非单纯翻译）的方式构建，用于评估模型的六项韩语能力，并发现韩语基准分数受任务构建、评分规则、提示词和后训练的影响，因此评估应同时报告分数及其实验设置。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces KBS, a Korean benchmark suite built through review, localization, direct Korean construction, and redesign rather than translation alone, showing that Korean benchmark scores depend on task construction, scoring rules, prompting, and post-training, and thus evaluations should report both scores and their settings.
